<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hatzalah Africa Company Limited | Unlocking Human Potential, Protecting Our Planet</title>
<meta name="description" content="Hatzalah Africa Company Limited – human capital development, economic empowerment, clean energy promotion and carbon credit monetization across Africa. Based in Dodoma, Tanzania.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#e5103a">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fira+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --orange:#ff5a00; --red:#e5103a; --ink:#14181f; --slate:#2d3440;
  --grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5a00,#e5103a);
  --bg:#ffffff; --bg-alt:#f6f4f2; --card:#ffffff; --text:#1f2530; --muted:#5b6472;
  --line:#e6e2dd; --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,24,31,.08); --radius:18px;
  --head:'Fira Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; --body:'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0f1319; --bg-alt:#151a22; --card:#1b212b; --text:#e9edf3; --muted:#9aa5b5;
  --line:#2a323f; --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
body{font-family:var(--body);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.7;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;transition:background .3s,color .3s}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--head);line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.7rem);margin-bottom:1.2rem}
h3{font-size:1.5rem}
p{margin-bottom:1rem;color:var(--muted)}
.container{width:min(1180px,92%);margin-inline:auto}
.section{padding:clamp(4rem,8vw,7rem) 0;position:relative}
.section.alt{background:var(--bg-alt)}
.section-head{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 3rem;text-align:center}
.section-head p{font-size:1.1rem}
.eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:1rem}
.eyebrow.dark{color:var(--red)}
.grad-text{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}

/* progress */
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:0;background:var(--grad);z-index:2000}

/* header */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1500;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .site-header{background:rgba(15,19,25,.88)}
.site-header.scrolled{box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.nav-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;height:72px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;text-decoration:none}
.brand-logo{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:4px;display:grid;place-items:center;height:48px;width:48px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.brand-logo img{height:100%;width:auto;object-fit:contain}
.brand-text{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:800;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.02em}
.brand-text small{display:block;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted)}
nav ul{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem}
nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:.93rem;padding:.55rem .85rem;border-radius:999px;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
nav a:hover{background:var(--bg-alt)}
nav a.active{color:var(--red);background:rgba(229,16,58,.08)}
nav a.nav-cta{background:var(--grad);color:#fff!important;font-weight:600}
.nav-tools{display:flex;gap:.5rem;align-items:center}
.icon-btn{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--text);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .2s}
.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-alt)}
.burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:12px}
.burger span{display:block;width:18px;height:2px;background:currentColor;transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.burger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;padding:.95rem 1.7rem;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,background .2s}
.btn-primary{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(229,16,58,.35)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(229,16,58,.45)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);color:#fff}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.full{width:100%}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;color:#fff;min-height:calc(100vh - 72px);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:4rem 0 6rem;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:-2;transform:scale(1.05)}
.hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(14,18,26,.94) 0%,rgba(14,18,26,.82) 45%,rgba(229,16,58,.55) 100%)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.2vw,4.2rem);margin-bottom:1.3rem;font-weight:900}
.hero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-size:1.15rem;max-width:560px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;margin:2rem 0}
.trust{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.6rem}
.trust li{font-size:.82rem;padding:.4rem .9rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.hero-card{position:relative;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform:rotate(2deg);border:6px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.hero-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:5/4;object-fit:cover}
.hero-badge{position:absolute;left:1rem;bottom:1rem;background:var(--grad);padding:.7rem 1.1rem;border-radius:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.2}
.hero-badge span{font-size:.8rem;opacity:.9}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:1.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:26px;height:42px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:20px}
.scroll-hint span{position:absolute;left:50%;top:8px;width:4px;height:8px;margin-left:-2px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;animation:wheel 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes wheel{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}

/* layout helpers */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(2rem,5vw,4.5rem);align-items:center}
.grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem}
.grid-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.4rem}
.sub-title{text-align:center;margin:5rem 0 2rem;font-size:1.6rem}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:2rem;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(229,16,58,.15)}
.pillar .num{display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.pillar h4{font-size:1.2rem;margin-bottom:.7rem}
.reg{margin-top:1.5rem;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;border-left:5px solid var(--red);background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}
.reg h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.reg p{margin:0;font-size:.95rem}
.about-visual{position:relative}
.about-visual>img{border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow);aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;width:100%;max-height:560px}
.logo-chip{position:absolute;right:-1rem;bottom:2rem;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:.8rem 1rem;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.25);width:min(190px,45%)}

/* tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;margin-bottom:2rem}
.tab{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);padding:.7rem 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.tab:hover{border-color:var(--red)}
.tab.active{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}
.tab-panels{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,3rem);box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:200px}
.panel{animation:fade .45s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.big-quote{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.55rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.55;color:var(--text);margin:0;position:relative;padding-left:1.2rem;border-left:5px solid var(--orange)}
.values details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:1rem 0}
.values details:last-child{border:0}
.values summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.values summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.values summary::after{content:'+';font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--red);transition:transform .3s}
.values details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.values details p{margin:.7rem 0 0}

/* services */
.services{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;gap:2rem}
.svc-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem}
.svc-tab{text-align:left;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;padding:1.1rem 1.2rem;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:center;transition:all .25s}
.svc-tab span{color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.svc-tab:hover{transform:translateX(4px);border-color:var(--red)}
.svc-tab.active{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(229,16,58,.3)}
.svc-tab.active span{color:#fff}
.svc-body{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(1.5rem,3.5vw,2.8rem);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.svc-panel{animation:fade .45s ease}
.svc-panel h3{font-size:1.9rem;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.lead{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--text)}
.ticks{list-style:none;margin-top:1rem;display:grid;gap:.7rem}
.ticks li{padding:.8rem 1rem .8rem 3rem;background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:12px;position:relative;font-weight:500}
.ticks li::before{content:'✓';position:absolute;left:1rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.8rem}
.mini-grid{display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:1rem}
.mini{padding:1.2rem 1.4rem;background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:14px;border-left:5px solid var(--orange)}
.mini h4{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.mini p{margin:0;font-size:.97rem}

/* women */
.women{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,rgba(255,90,0,.07) 100%)}
.women-visual{position:relative;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:1.5rem}
.women-visual .wlogo{width:70%;margin:1rem auto 0}
.steps{display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
.step{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:1.1rem 1.3rem;border-radius:14px;transition:transform .25s}
.step:hover{transform:translateX(6px)}
.step>span{flex:none;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:800}
.step h4{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.2rem}
.step p{margin:0;font-size:.95rem}

/* leadership */
.leader{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:3rem;align-items:start}
.leader-photos{position:sticky;top:100px;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:var(--ink)}
.leader-photos img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover}
.leader-id{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:1.4rem;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(14,18,26,.92),transparent)}
.leader-id strong{display:block;font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.2rem}
.leader-id span{font-size:.88rem;opacity:.85}
blockquote{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:1.3rem;color:var(--text);background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.more p{animation:fade .5s ease}
.sign{margin-top:1.5rem;color:var(--text)}
.sign em{font-family:'Brush Script MT','Segoe Script',cursive;font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--red)}
.link-btn{background:none;border:0;color:var(--red);font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:.3rem 0}
.link-btn:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.founder{display:grid;grid-template-columns:320px 1fr;gap:2.5rem;align-items:center;margin-top:4.5rem;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.5rem);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.founder img{border-radius:var(--radius);aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;width:100%}
.founder h3{margin-bottom:1rem}
.quals{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:1.3rem}
.quals li{padding:.6rem 1rem;background:var(--bg-alt);border-radius:10px;border-left:4px solid var(--red);font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500}

/* why */
.why{color:#fff;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.why-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:-2}
.why::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(14,18,26,.94),rgba(120,12,40,.88));z-index:-1}
.section-head.light h2{color:#fff}
.why-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);padding:1.8rem;border-radius:var(--radius);transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
.why-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.why-card p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);margin:0;font-size:.97rem}
.why-card h4{margin:.9rem 0 .5rem;font-size:1.2rem}
.ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--grad);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.5rem}

/* contact */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2rem;align-items:stretch}
.contact-info{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.contact-info>img{width:100%;height:240px;object-fit:cover}
.info-list{list-style:none;padding:1.6rem;display:grid;gap:1.2rem}
.info-list li{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}
.info-list .i{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-alt);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.2rem}
.info-list strong{display:block;font-family:var(--head)}
.info-list a{color:var(--red);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.info-list a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.info-list div{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem}
.form{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.4rem);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.form h3{margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.form label{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.form input,.form select,.form textarea{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:.4rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;font:inherit;font-weight:400;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;transition:border .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.form input:focus,.form select:focus,.form textarea:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(229,16,58,.15)}
.form .invalid{border-color:#d62839!important}
.form-status{margin:1rem 0 0;font-weight:600;text-align:center}
.form-status.ok{color:#198754}.form-status.err{color:#d62839}
.map{margin-top:2rem;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.map iframe{width:100%;height:360px;border:0;display:block}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .map iframe{filter:invert(.9) hue-rotate(180deg)}

/* footer */
.footer{background:#0d1117;color:#c8d0dc;padding:4rem 0 1.5rem}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1.2fr;gap:3rem}
.foot-logo{background:#fff;display:inline-block;padding:.8rem 1rem;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:1rem}
.foot-logo img{height:110px;width:auto}
.footer .tag{font-style:italic;color:#9aa5b5;max-width:380px}
.footer h4{color:#fff;margin-bottom:1rem}
.footer ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:.5rem;font-size:.95rem}
.footer a{text-decoration:none}.footer a:hover{color:var(--orange)}
.copy{margin-top:3rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid #222a36;font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;color:#7d8798}
.to-top{position:fixed;right:1.2rem;bottom:1.2rem;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(229,16,58,.4);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(10px);transition:all .3s;z-index:1400}
.to-top.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}

/* reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.grid-3 .reveal:nth-child(2),.grid-4 .reveal:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.1s}
.grid-3 .reveal:nth-child(3),.grid-4 .reveal:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.2s}
.grid-4 .reveal:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.3s}

/* responsive */
@media (max-width:1020px){
  .hero-grid,.split,.leader,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-card{max-width:520px;transform:none}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .services{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .svc-nav{flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.4rem;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}
  .svc-tab{flex:none;scroll-snap-align:start}
  .leader-photos{position:relative;top:0;max-width:420px}
  .founder{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .founder img{max-width:320px}
  .about-visual>img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .burger{display:flex}
  nav{position:fixed;top:72px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease;box-shadow:0 20px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
  nav.open{max-height:80vh;overflow:auto}
  nav ul{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:1rem 4%;gap:.2rem}
  nav a{display:block;padding:.9rem 1rem;border-radius:12px}
  nav a.nav-cta{text-align:center;margin-top:.4rem}
}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .grid-4,.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .brand-text{font-size:.88rem}
  .hero{padding-top:3rem}
  .logo-chip{right:.6rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="progress" id="progress" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<header class="site-header" id="header">
  <div class="container nav-wrap">
    <a href="#home" class="brand" aria-label="Hatzalah Africa Company Limited – home">
      <span class="brand-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Hatzalah Africa logo"></span>
      <span class="brand-text">HATZALAH AFRICA<small>COMPANY LIMITED</small></span>
    </a>
    <nav id="nav" aria-label="Main">
      <ul>
        <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
        <li><a href="#vision">Vision &amp; Values</a></li>
        <li><a href="#services">Services</a></li>
        <li><a href="#women">Women Initiative</a></li>
        <li><a href="#leadership">Leadership</a></li>
        <li><a href="#why">Why Us</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact" class="nav-cta">Contact</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
    <div class="nav-tools">
      <button class="icon-btn" id="themeBtn" aria-label="Toggle dark mode" title="Toggle dark mode">

<!-- LEADERSHIP -->
<section id="leadership" class="section alt">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow dark">Leadership</span>
      <h2>A message from our CEO</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="leader">
      <div class="leader-photos reveal">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ms. Rosemary Chambe Jairo, Chief Executive Officer, seated in a red patterned dress" loading="lazy">
        <div class="leader-id">
          <strong>Ms. Rosemary Chambe Jairo</strong>
          <span>Founder &amp; Chief Executive Officer</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="leader-text reveal">
        <blockquote>"Unlocking Human Potential, Protecting Our Planet"</blockquote>
        <p>At Hatzalah Africa Company Limited, we believe that Africa's greatest resource is its people. The strength of our continent lies not only in its natural wealth but in the untapped potential of its human capital. Our mission is to unlock that potential by equipping individuals, businesses and communities with the skills, opportunities and resources they need to thrive in a rapidly changing world.</p>
        <div class="more" id="ceoMore" hidden>
          <p>In an era defined by innovation, climate change and global competitiveness, human capacity development is no longer optional – it is essential. We have expanded our mandate to include Clean Energy Promotion, recognizing that economic growth cannot occur at the expense of environmental health. By promoting clean cooking solutions, we are tackling deforestation, improving public health and mitigating indoor air pollution.</p>
          <p>Furthermore, we are pioneering Carbon Credit Mechanisms that convert these environmental actions into sustainable revenue streams for local communities. This ensures that communities are not just adopting clean energy, but are financially rewarded for their climate-positive actions. By investing in education, green skills, entrepreneurship and inclusive economic systems, we are laying the foundation for sustainable prosperity that benefits generations to come.</p>
          <p>As CEO, I am confident that with determination, collaboration and strategic investment in people and climate resilience, Hatzalah Africa Company Limited will continue to play a pivotal role in driving human capital development, economic transformation and environmental sustainability across the continent.</p>
          <p class="sign"><em>Rosemary Chambe Jairo</em><br>Ms. Rosemary Chambe Jairo<br>Chief Executive Officer, Hatzalah Africa Company Limited</p>
        </div>
        <button class="link-btn" id="ceoToggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="ceoMore">Read the full message <span aria-hidden="true">↓</span></button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="founder reveal">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ms. Rosemary Chambe Jairo, Founder, in a navy blazer" loading="lazy">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow dark">Founder's qualifications &amp; our belief</span>
        <h3>Making a difference where it matters most</h3>
        <ul class="quals">
          <li>MA Peace and Security Studies</li>
          <li>Postgraduate Diploma, Administrative and Information Management (Financial Services Operations and Systems Development)</li>
          <li>Bachelor of Arts Education in Political Science &amp; International Relations</li>
          <li>Certificate in Teaching Kiswahili as a Foreign Language</li>
        </ul>
        <p>Founded in 2024, Hatzalah Africa is built upon decades of experience from our Founder in Foreign Service. The firm leverages this deep background in human rights, governance and development to advance human security across the African continent, addressing the interconnected issues of poverty, unemployment, health, education, security, water, sanitation and environmental degradation.</p>
        <p>Building on this foundation, we have expanded our technical expertise into Clean Energy Access and Carbon Markets. We believe that the transition to clean cooking is a human security issue, and carbon credits offer a pioneering financial bridge to make this transition affordable for low-income households while protecting Tanzania's vital forest reserves.</p>

<button class="to-top" id="toTop" aria-label="Back to top">↑</button>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var $ = function (s, c) { return (c || document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function (s, c) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((c || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };

  // Theme
  var root = document.documentElement;
  try {
    var saved = localStorage.getItem('hz-theme');
    if (saved) root.setAttribute('data-theme', saved);
    else if (window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
  } catch (e) {}
  $('#themeBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var next = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    try { localStorage.setItem('hz-theme', next); } catch (e) {}
  });

  // Mobile nav
  var burger = $('#burger'), nav = $('#nav');
  function closeNav() { nav.classList.remove('open'); burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
  burger.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  $$('#nav a').forEach(function (a) { a.addEventListener('click', closeNav); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeNav(); });

  // Scroll: progress bar, header shadow, back-to-top
  var progress = $('#progress'), header = $('#header'), toTop = $('#toTop');
  function onScroll() {
    var h = document.documentElement;
    var max = h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight;
    progress.style.width = (max > 0 ? (h.scrollTop / max) * 100 : 0) + '%';
    header.classList.toggle('scrolled', h.scrollTop > 10);
    toTop.classList.toggle('show', h.scrollTop > 700);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();
  toTop.addEventListener('click', function () { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); });

  // Reveal on scroll
  var reveals = $$('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) { en.target.classList.add('visible'); io.unobserve(en.target); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    reveals.forEach(function (r) { io.observe(r); });
  } else reveals.forEach(function (r) { r.classList.add('visible'); });

  // Active nav link
  var links = $$('#nav a[href^="#"]:not(.nav-cta)');
  var sections = links.map(function (a) { return $(a.getAttribute('href')); }).filter(Boolean);
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    var so = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (en) {
        if (en.isIntersecting) {
          links.forEach(function (a) { a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + en.target.id); });
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
    sections.forEach(function (s) { so.observe(s); });
  }

  // Generic tab helper
  function tabs(tabSel, panelFor, activate) {
    var list = $$(tabSel);
    list.forEach(function (t, i) {
      t.addEventListener('click', function () { activate(t); });
      t.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        var n = null;
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') n = list[(i + 1) % list.length];
        if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') n = list[(i - 1 + list.length) % list.length];
        if (n) { e.preventDefault(); n.focus(); activate(n); }
      });
    });
  }
  // Vision / mission / values
  tabs('.tab', null, function (t) {
    $$('.tab').forEach(function (x) {
      var on = x === t;
      x.classList.toggle('active', on);
      x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on);
      var p = $('#' + x.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
      p.hidden = !on; p.classList.toggle('active', on);
    });
  });
  // Services
  tabs('.svc-tab', null, function (t) {
    $$('.svc-tab').forEach(function (x) {
      var on = x === t;
      x.classList.toggle('active', on);
      x.setAttribute('aria-selected', on);
      $('#svc-' + x.getAttribute('data-svc')).hidden = !on;
    });
  });

  // CEO message toggle
  var ceoBtn = $('#ceoToggle'), ceoMore = $('#ceoMore');
  ceoBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var open = ceoMore.hidden;
    ceoMore.hidden = !open;
    ceoBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
    ceoBtn.firstChild.textContent = open ? 'Show less ' : 'Read the full message ';
    ceoBtn.lastElementChild.textContent = open ? '↑' : '↓';
  });

  // Contact form (static site: opens the visitor's email app addressed to info@hatzalahs.com)
  var form = $('#contactForm'), status = $('#formStatus');
  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var name = $('#fName'), email = $('#fEmail'), msg = $('#fMsg');
    var ok = true;
    [name, email, msg].forEach(function (f) {
      var bad = !f.value.trim() || (f.type === 'email' && !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(f.value));
      f.classList.toggle('invalid', bad);
      if (bad) ok = false;
    });
    status.className = 'form-status';
    if (!ok) { status.textContent = 'Please fill in all fields with valid details.'; status.classList.add('err'); return; }
    var subject = 'Website enquiry: ' + $('#fTopic').value;
    var body = 'Name: ' + name.value.trim() + '\nEmail: ' + email.value.trim() + '\n\n' + msg.value.trim();
    window.location.href = 'mailto:info@hatzalahs.com?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subject) + '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(body);
    status.textContent = 'Thank you, ' + name.value.trim() + '. Your email app should open with your message ready to send.';
    status.classList.add('ok');
    form.reset();
  });

  $('#year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
